_about: Public Express and Next.js apps Veridic is measured on, pinned to exact commits. `dev` apps were used while improving route discovery and effect tracing; `holdout` apps were first run only after that, and their first-run results are recorded in holdout_first_run. `nextjs` apps (framework: nextjs) are counted by a separate independent scan for Next.js routes.

repos.name: juice-shop
repos.about: OWASP Juice Shop: intentionally insecure shop (TypeScript)

repos.name: node-express-boilerplate
repos.about: REST boilerplate, Mongoose, route lists mounted in a loop

repos.name: node-express-mongoose-demo
repos.about: Mongoose demo, routes registered on an app parameter

repos.name: saas-starter
repos.about: Next.js SaaS starter: app router, server actions, Drizzle, Stripe

repos.name: nextjs-subscription-payments
repos.about: Vercel's subscription starter: Supabase auth and data, Stripe

repos.name: taxonomy
repos.about: shadcn's Taxonomy: app router + pages/api, NextAuth, Prisma, Stripe

repos.name: papermark
repos.about: Papermark document sharing: pages/api and app router, NextAuth, Prisma

repos.name: inbox-zero
repos.about: Inbox Zero email assistant: monorepo, app router, server actions, Prisma

holdout_first_run._about: Route discovery on the holdout apps the first time Veridic saw them, before the fixes they prompted (an app handed into a function).
